'''Reeveid''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. [[Tirog]], a fellow bounty hunter, arranged to meet with Reeveid in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Tirog waited half an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] for Reeveid.<ref name="RPG2" /> [[Thannik]], another bounty hunter, also once arranged to meet with Reeveid in a cantina on business. Thannik waited for about half an hour before Reeveid arrived.<ref name="Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
